# Joel Chapter 3 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 334r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/JOL_003_page_001.jpg

---

**1** "In those days, when I restore the prosperity of Judah and Jerusalem," says the LORD, **2** "I will gather the armies of the world into the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will judge them for harming my people, my special possession — for scattering the Israelites among the nations and for dividing up my land. **3** They threw dice to decide which of my people would be their slaves. They traded boys to prostitutes for sex, and sold girls for enough wine to get drunk."

**4** "What do you have against me, Tyre and Sidon and you cities of Philistia? Are you trying to pay me back for something? If so, I will pay you back swiftly and speedily! **5** You took my silver and gold and carried off my finest treasures to your pagan temples. **6** You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, sending them far from their homeland. **7** But I will bring them back from all the places where you sold them, and I will pay you back for what you have done."

**8** "I will sell your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the people of Arabia, who will take them to a distant land. I, the LORD, have spoken!"

**9** Announce this to the nations: Prepare for war! Call out your best warriors! Let all your fighting men advance for the attack! **10** Hammer your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Train even the weaklings to be warriors! **11** Come quickly, all you nations everywhere — gather for battle. Send down your warriors, LORD!

**12** "Let the nations be called to arms. Let them march to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I, the LORD, will sit to pronounce judgment on them all."

**13** Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe! Come, stomp the grapes, for the winepress is full and the vats are overflowing — so great is the wickedness of these people!

**14** Thousands upon thousands are waiting in the valley of decision. For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision. **15** The sun and moon grow dark, and the stars no longer shine.

**16** The LORD's voice will thunder from Zion and roar from Jerusalem, and the heavens and the earth will shake. But to his people the LORD will be a refuge, a fortress for the people of Israel.

**17** "Then you will know that I, the LORD your God, live in Zion, my holy mountain. Jerusalem will be holy forever, and foreign armies will never conquer her again."

**18** "In that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine, and the hills will flow with milk. Water will fill the dry streambeds of Judah, and a fountain will flow from the LORD's Temple, watering the arid Valley of Acacias."

**19** "But Egypt will become a wasteland and Edom a desert, because of the violence they did to the people of Judah — they murdered innocent people in their land."

**20** "But Judah will be filled with people forever, and Jerusalem will endure through all generations. **21** I will pardon my people's blood, which I have not yet pardoned." The LORD makes his home in Zion.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**"Beat plowshares into swords" (v.10):** This is one of the most striking reversals in the Bible. Isaiah (2:4) and Micah (4:3) famously envision a day when weapons are recycled into farming tools. Joel deliberately inverts it — commanding the nations to arm themselves. But the irony is brutal: the nations prepare for war only to meet YHWH's judgment. They arm themselves for their own destruction.

**"Multitudes in the valley of decision" (v.14):** The Hebrew *emeq ha-charuts* — the "valley of the verdict" or "the valley where things are decided." Not where the nations make their decision, but where God makes his. The nations think they are gathering for war; they are actually gathering for judgment.

**The fountain from the Temple (v.18):** Joel's final vision mirrors Ezekiel 47 — a stream flowing from God's house that transforms a barren wilderness into abundance. Mountains drip wine, hills flow with milk, dry riverbeds run with water. It's the Garden of Eden restored — creation healed at its source.

*— PNEUMA*
